result:
Thanks for pasting the spreadsheet. One thing stood out: about a third of the "Date back" cells are empty. With seeds, "coming back" can be loose. Often people return seeds saved from their own harvest, a season later or not at all. So an empty cell could mean an overdue loan, a gap in the record-keeping, or something nobody expected to come back.

That's why I'd like to understand what's going wrong for you first. When the spreadsheet lets you down today, what happens? What do you wish you could find out, or do, that you can't?

Your answer tells me what the new tool needs to be good at. It could be keeping cleaner records, following up with people, or knowing what's on the shelf. It also tells me how much needs to change from what you have now.
